clauses.quote: DCPS shall be responsible for furnishing and maintaining conditions of employment that are free of hazards that are causing, or are likely to cause accidents, injury or illness to employees.

Employees shall be guaranteed protection from any restraint, interference, coercion, discrimination or reprisal for filing a report of an unsafe or unhealthful condition, or for any other participation in a safety program.
The Teachers in the affected area may submit evidence to the Personnel Committee for their consideration.
clauses.subject_text: The Teachers in the affected area

clauses.quote: An individual who is in the affected area shall recuse him or herself from the Personnel Committee for this decision.
clauses.subject_text: An individual who is in the affected area
